content.short: A progressive community that is based on true ownership, equality and transparency.
content.description:
Osmium DAO aims to create a progressive community that is based on true ownership, equality and transparency by leveraging the potentials and capabilities of DAOs and NFTs.

Osmium DAO is meant to represent a professionally managed treasury owned by the community. It aims to create a sustainable, perpetual treasury through various established business models owned directly by the token holders, governed by OsmiumShare NFT holders. The DAO also aims to grow the treasury and pay out dividends in perpetuity. Finally, the DAO plans to educate the broader crypto community on the benefits of risk management, nurturing and managing a diversified portfolio in a decentralized way.
